note:
R41 - CTX0 v3.1 (NHL 11 / 12, 4-byte magic) context records decoded by pointer walk (the v4.5 decode is r24). Read-only.

File: `CTX0 | u16 3, u16 1 | 0 | u32 n | u32 A | u32 n | 0 0 0 | A x (u32 hash, 0, 0, 0) | n x u32 record ptr (absolute, unsorted)`.
Record (19 words): `w0 w1 (time-like) | w2 | w3 | w4 | w5 hash | 0 0 0 0 | ff | w11 -> trigger block or ff | w12 -> item block | ff |
  w14 = ncond | w15 -> ncond x ptr | w16 = nextra | w17 -> nextra x u32 or ff | w18 -> context name (inline NUL string)`.
Trigger block: `0 | u32 ns<<16|id (context MOIR) | nargs | 0 | 0 | nargs x u32 (1..nargs = parameter slots) | name`.
Item block: `0 | u32 ns<<16|id (speech MOIR ns 0x761, or another module ns) | 0 | 0 | nparams | 0 | ptr -> name | nparams x (kind, ptr)`:
  kind 0 = ptr to a trigger parameter-slot word (its value = the slot index), kind 1 = ptr to an expression `0 | blob | nargs | nargs x (kind, ptr)`.
Condition: `nargs | ptr -> nargs x ptr (to trigger slot words) or ff | blob index | 0 | name`.
Checks: trigger id in the context MOIR with the same name; item id in the speech MOIR with the same name; blob indices < .gas blob count;
X360 = PS3 record-for-record (NHL 11); NHL 12 same layout.
Usage: python r41_ctx0_v31_records.py <out.json>
